known_blockers.summary: EVERY Pages-Router route in this office app fails to hydrate on the client. Verified across /prediction-admin/settlements, /prediction-admin/markets, and /logs: the page+container+_app JS modules all evaluate, but NO React component renders client-side (AppComponent/SessionGuard/page/container render markers never fire), there are ZERO client errors (window.onerror + unhandledrejection + console.error all empty with _app.js suppression disabled), and no DOM node has a React fiber. Only SSR HTML is shown; effects never run; data never loads. App-Router routes (/auth/login, /dashboard, /audit-logs) hydrate fine. Root cause is above components/app — pages/_app.js evaluates but appWithTranslation(PhoenixApp) -> AppComponent never renders: a Next.js App-Router + Pages-Router + next-i18next (appWithTranslation) dual-router client-bootstrap incompatibility.
known_blockers.impact: All Pages-Router admin surfaces (prediction-admin/markets, prediction-admin/settlements, logs, terms-and-conditions, market-categories) are server-rendered but non-interactive: tables never populate, buttons/modals/forms do nothing. The 'settlements/markets show 0 markets' symptom is one facet of this.
known_blockers.not_the_cause: Ruled out (each verified): data/CORS (gateway returns 22 closed markets; raw fetch from page ctx OK), the useApi render-loop (fixed 4e148445), hydration text-mismatch (none captured), the useApiHookTyped SSR pre-hooks early-return (fixed 6ab68903, clean-rebuilt, still no hydration).
known_blockers.recommended_fix: Architectural, not a patch: migrate the prediction-admin Pages-Router pages to the App Router (the office's active tree per root CLAUDE.md), OR fix the App+Pages+next-i18next client bootstrap. next-i18next/appWithTranslation is Pages-Router-only and is the prime suspect when an app/ dir coexists. Do NOT attempt under time pressure or unsupervised on the deployed branch.
known_blockers.fixes_shipped_enroute: ROUTE_AUTH /auth->/auth/login 404 auth-thrash (ed71d8c3), useApi triggerApi useCallback memo killing the app-router Maximum-update-depth loop (4e148445), useApiHookTyped hooks-stable SSR fix (6ab68903) — all real, verified, pushed; none resolves this dual-router blocker.
